source.extractionPreview:
Chapter 14
Harmony in Motion
India boasts of a rich tapestry of 
traditional 
dances, 
each 
deeply 
rooted in the country's diverse 
cultural 
heritage. 
These 
dances 
are not merely an expression of 
movement, but also convey stories, 
emotions and spirituality. 
A traditional dance may be 
shastriya nritya or loka nritya. The 
variety of dance in our culture 
spreads different fragrances which 
are unique in nature.
We have numerous instruments, 
properties, costumes, languages and 
cultural
